name: Mast
author: Stackrats
description: Your Laravel Sail projects in the Omarchy bar: see what is running at a glance, then start, stop, restart and open projects from a keyboard-friendly panel.

barWidget.description: Running project count in the bar, and a panel to start, stop, restart and open your Sail projects.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the bar asks Mast for project state. The panel polls faster while it is open.

schema.label: Bar label
schema.description: ratio shows running/total projects, running shows only the running count, none shows just the mark.

schema.label: Hide when the Mast CLI is missing
schema.description: Take the widget out of the bar instead of showing a dimmed mark when mast is not installed.

schema.label: mast binary
schema.description: Absolute path to the mast executable. Leave empty to find it on your login shell PATH.
